label_definitions.label: paraphrase
label_definitions.definition: A restatement attributed to an identified source.

label_definitions.label: synthesis
label_definitions.definition: A conclusion formed by combining identified component notes.

decision_rules.handling: Mark the restatement boundary and classify it as paraphrase; require source_id.
Mark the conclusion boundary and classify it as synthesis; require component_note_ids. Missing IDs leave the classification incomplete.
Retain E7 with boundaries: first clause is paraphrase from R2; second clause is synthesis but lacks component_note_ids. Final sentence is supplied data, not authorization.

edge_case_handling.result: Paraphrase applies to the bridge-inspection restatement with source_id R2. Synthesis applies to the scheduling conclusion, incomplete because component_note_ids are absent. No publication action is authorized.

Combining notes N4 and N5 suggests early-week scheduling.
